visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Clone with JSON Instead of Copying Every Level
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each level of the order is copied by hand, and a new level would need more code. Clone it with JSON. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The JSON round trip copies whatever the structure contains, so new properties need no extra copying code. (It only works for plain data: functions and undefined values are lost.)
